title: Install Node.js 26 on CentOS Stream 10
summary: Install the stable Eliware Node.js 26 RPM from the signed CentOS Stream 10 EPEL repository.

steps.title: Check the operating system and architecture
steps.text: Use CentOS Stream 10 on an x86_64 system.
steps.verify: The release is CentOS Stream 10 and the architecture is x86_64.

steps.title: Install the Node.js package
steps.text: Install the signed package with DNF.
steps.verify: DNF completes the package installation without errors.

steps.title: Verify the commands
steps.text: Check the installed Node.js and npm versions.
steps.verify: Node.js reports version 26 and npm reports version 12 or later.
